meta.title: Settings
meta.description: Your profile, security, API tokens and data.

profile.description: This is how the people you share boards with see you.
profile.name: Name
profile.currentPasswordHint: Only needed if you change your email.
profile.photoHint: It is cropped to a square and shown next to your name on boards, cards and comments. Only people who share an organization or a board with you can see it.

security.description: Changing your password signs out your other sessions.
security.sessionsHint: Every browser where your account is signed in. Close the ones you do not recognise.

tokens.description: To use the orgtable API from scripts or other apps. A token acts as you, with the same access to boards, and is only shown once. See the API documentation.
tokens.empty: You haven't created any tokens yet.

form.copyNow: Copy it now: for security reasons it won't be shown again.
form.copyFailed: Couldn't copy automatically: select the token and copy it by hand.
form.name: Token name

appearance.description: Theme and language of the interface.

data.description: Your GDPR rights, without having to write to anyone. The details are in the <link>privacy policy</link>.

export.title: Download my data
export.description: A JSON file with your account, your boards, your comments, your notifications and your security log.

delete.title: Delete my account
delete.descriptionNoBoards: Your account and your comments are deleted forever. Other people's boards remain, without you. This can't be undone.

descriptionWithBoards.one: Your account, the board you created (with its cards and attachments) and your comments are deleted forever. Other people's boards remain, without you. This can't be undone.
descriptionWithBoards.other: Your account, the {count} boards you created (with their cards and attachments) and your comments are deleted forever. Other people's boards remain, without you. This can't be undone.

workspaces.description: Your personal boards and the organizations you belong to.

twoFactor.title: Two-step verification
twoFactor.off: Off. Besides your password, ask for a code from an app on your phone (Google Authenticator, 1Password, Aegis…).
twoFactor.noKey: This instance cannot keep two-step secrets yet (ORGTABLE_SECRET_KEY is missing). Whoever runs it can add it.
twoFactor.setupIntro: Three steps: scan the code, type the code the app shows, and save your recovery codes.
twoFactor.step1: 1. Scan this code with your authenticator app
twoFactor.manual: Can't scan it? Type this key:
twoFactor.codesText: If you lose your phone, each of these codes lets you in once. They will not be shown again: keep them in a password manager or print them.
twoFactor.regenerateText: The old ones stop working. Type your password to continue.
twoFactor.disableText: Type your password and a code from the app (or a recovery code).
twoFactor.requiredBy: Required by {names}: their boards stay closed to you without it.
